[हु-कर्मणि यत्] To be offered in oblations. --व्यं 1 Clarified butter. --2 An oblation or offering to the gods (opp. कव्य q. v.). --3 An oblation in general. --Comp. --आशः fire. --कव्यं oblations to the gods and to the Manes, or spirits of deceased ancestors; Ms. 1. 94, 3. 97, 128; et seq. --पाकः an oblation cooked with butter and milk, or the pot in which it is cooked. --वाह्, --वाह, --वाहन m. ‘the bearer of oblations’, fire.

k.v: पृषदाज्यं सदध्याज्ये परमान्नं तु पायसम्. हव्यकव्ये दैवपित्र्ये अन्ने पात्रं स्रुवादिकम्.।

हव्य—क˚व्याश mfn. eating both obl˚, Pañcar.
हव्य—कव्य n. oblations both to the gods and to the spirits of deceased ancestors, Mn. iii, 190
हव्य—कव्य—वह mfn. receiving both oblations (cf. above), MBh. conveying both oblations, ib.
हव्य—लेहिन् m. ‘obl˚-licker’, fire, the god of fire, Bālar.
हव्य—मन्त्राधिकृत m. du. ‘superintendent of the sacrifice and of the council’, a priest and a minister, Bcar. x, 1.
